errors.evidence: The countries on the x-axis are not listed in alphabetical order (Finland, Luxembourg, Sweden...). They are sorted in ascending order based on their percentage values.

errors.text_span: Няма видима подредба или групиране на стълбовете извън азбучната последователност на държавите по хоризонталната ос, като стойностите на процентите се изменят постепенно от най-ниските към най-високите.
errors.evidence: This sentence is self-contradictory. It first incorrectly claims there is no arrangement other than alphabetical, and then correctly states that the values are arranged from lowest to highest.
The value for Bulgaria is approximately 59%, not 57%.
The value for Greece is approximately 45%, not 43%.
The value for EU28 is approximately 18%, not 16%.
